messages:
Ana: Pasting a fresh mock for billing—asking the group: default view after login = Project rollups (compact cards) or Account ledger (detailed rows)? Trying to balance PLG glanceability vs auditability.
Devon: Can we see the frames? also how does this behave on narrow screens?
Ana: figma.redwood/pm/billing-new (frames: rollup-grid, ledger-list, mobile-drawer). Rollups show project totals + USD est; ledger shows invoice rows and line-item chevrons.
Lucy: From CS calls, small startups prefer the compact grid. Enterprise folks want invoice rows with visible Download CTA. Maybe default to rollup for new orgs and remember last-view for returning users.
Sasha: Technical: rollup = one metadata fetch per project. Ledger = pagination + per-invoice line endpoints. We should lazy-load ledger lines on open (GET /orgs/:id/invoices?page=1). ETag the rollup payload for quick 304s.
Matt: Copy: primary action on invoice = "Save as PDF". Secondary "Export CSV". For rollups, use an inline "View ledger" button. Also recommend explicit aria-labels: e.g., aria-label="Save invoice as PDF".
Jordan: Telemetry: add events billing.view.default (rollup|ledger), billing.rollup.expand, billing.ledger.download_pdf, billing.ledger.export_csv. Also track scope toggles: billing.scope.switch.
Devon: Scope question: top scope chip (next to search) vs left-rail selector. Top chip is discoverable but collides with onboarding banners. Left rail is stable but hidden on narrow screens. Suggest top chip on widths > 1000px, else left-rail.
Ana: I'll prototype top-chip + left-rail fallback. Accessibility note: scope chip must have aria-haspopup and aria-expanded states and be reachable via keyboard in natural order.
Sasha: Accessibility nit: token denomination chips are currently using brand-400 text on brand-600 bg. Fails contrast for small text. Propose: increase font-weight to 600 or use neutral-0 on brand-600. Also ensure focus ring is visible (2px outline).
Lucy: For billing disputes, finance teams need visible invoice IDs. In ledger rows show last 4 chars of invoice id, but expose full id in tooltip or copy button.
Matt: UX tweak: rollups show aggregate tokens by default with a chevron to expand per-denomination. Expansion should reveal Input/Output/Context tokens with percent bars. Keep default collapsed to reduce churn.
Jordan: Metrics-wise collapsed->expanded is ~12% — safe default collapsed. Add quick search in ledger and keyboard shortcut (g then b) to jump to billing. Power users like that.
Devon: Mobile: rollup cards stack; ledger opens as full-screen drawer with sticky download actions. Avoid horizontal tables.
Ana: Visual detail: when expanding a project's ledger, highlight the row with highest cost using a 1px accent and add a tooltip "Top spend"; include a 30-day sparkline next to cost.
Sasha: Backend: add endpoint GET /orgs/:orgId/billing/summary?scope=project to serve cached aggregates. For ledger lines use range queries and provide total_count for pagination.
Lucy: Legal: invoices must include company tax details and a legal footer. UI can hide footer but PDF generation must always include full footer. Devon, can you confirm PDF pipeline includes full footer?
Devon: Yes, PDF renderer will include full footer regardless of UI collapse. Need to validate multi-page behavior for long ledgers.
Matt: Copy decision: Visible CTA = "Save as PDF"; aria-label = "Save invoice as PDF". CSV button label = "Export CSV" aria-label = "Export ledger as CSV". Keep verbs explicit.
Ana: Quick accessibility addition: announce export job status through an aria-live region and show a toast with a link when completed. billing-bot can post a thread message as well.
billing-bot: Export job created: id=exp-2201234567-01 status=queued (info).
Jordan: Dev tasks: Sasha to spec lazy endpoints + ETag TTL, Devon to validate PDF renderer, Matt to finalize CTAs & microcopy, Lucy to compile finance/legal footer copy, Ana to update frames with top-chip + left-rail fallback and both rollup/ledger defaults.
Ana: I'll push updated frames by tomorrow AM and tag everyone. Thanks! :thumbsup:
